idea.title: Booking Double-Check — detect double bookings across CSV exports
idea.sea_fit: Perfect fit for SE Asia’s booming freelance/agency market where manual CSV reviews are common due to low SaaS adoption.

plan.tagline: Detect double bookings across CSV exports in 60 seconds
plan.problem: Freelancers and small agencies waste hours manually cross-checking CSV exports from multiple booking platforms (Calendly, Google Calendar, Airbnb, etc.) for overlapping time slots, leading to overbookings and lost revenue.
plan.solution: 1) Import multiple CSV exports via CLI. 2) Normalize time zones and formats. 3) Store in SQLite. 4) Detect overlaps with 1-second precision. 5) Generate conflict reports with visual timelines and exportable summaries.
plan.target_market: Solo freelancers and small agencies in SE Asia managing bookings across multiple platforms (e.g., Airbnb hosts, tour operators, SaaS founders with Calendly integrations).
mvp_features: CSV import with auto-detection of date/time columns
CLI commands: add, list, check, report

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: SQLite schema for bookings + 'add' command to import CSV files

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Generate conflict reports with visual timelines and export summaries

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Add --demo mode with hardcoded data + polish CLI help/edge cases

plan.demo_script: Run: `doublecheck --demo`. Shows 3 bookings (2 overlapping) with a conflict report listing the overlap and exportable CSV/JSON summaries.
plan.phuket_angle: Phuket tour operators and Airbnb hosts juggling multiple booking platforms can use this to avoid double bookings during peak season (Dec-Apr), reducing refunds and negative reviews.
